sparse_attn_indexer and mla_attention coordinate via a module-level mutable state bag instead of an explicit interface
distributed.parallel_state is a hub imported by unrelated subsystems for runtime topology
quanttrio-tp4-dcp2/legacy-stack/kernels/sparse_attn_indexer.py is another fork of the same indexer logic
AEON archive duplicates the root overlay tree outside MANIFEST.json discipline
DSpark ring drafting capability is split across four top-level areas
Patch directories exist in three locations, with the same indexer patch duplicated
launch/ mixes production fleet hardening with experiment runner scripts
kernels/ mixes production writer with cute and rdma prototypes
README.md layout diagram omits several top-level directories and predates archives
overlays/optional/ only contains TailQuant, which also lives in campaign-2026-08/
campaign-2026-08/sircl/ is a full vendored transport codebase inside an archive
cudagraph_utils.py mixes dataclass, NamedTuple, and Protocol for related local abstractions without documented rationale
Archived subprojects aeon-crossnode-graphs/ and quanttrio-tp4-dcp2/ duplicate live overlay paths but are marked as production zone, creating sibling ambiguity
builda BMM registration failures are silently swallowed
Graph status reporter background loop silently swallows all exceptions
TailQuant profiler record and dump paths silently ignore all failures
Fatal native collective handlers catch BaseException but do not chain cause before exit
Benchmark probes silently skip malformed streaming response chunks
DSpark finetune loader mixes skip-on-error, return-None, and raise strategies
Atomic weight write failure is logged but the error object is discarded
Parallel-state rank probes silently collapse all exceptions to a default boolean
Generic verb 'process' hides specialized post-load dequant/absorption work in MLA attention layer.

dflash_speculator.propose takes attn_metadata as dict[str, Any] instead of a typed backend metadata class.
overlays/dspark-ring/kv_cache_manager.py is a high-ratio re-export facade with almost no dspark-ring logic of its own.

Production attention and MoE overlays carry upstream vLLM's broad vllm_config/attn_metadata parameter surfaces.

Overlay files import the third-party `regex` package as `re`, but the repo has no manifest declaring it.
VllmConfig.__post_init__ is a 732-line sequential validator/initializer with no internal decomposition
EngineArgs mixes 859 lines of CLI registration and 602 lines of config construction in two giant methods

sparse_attn_indexer mixes profile reservation, B12X gating, prefill chunk loops, and DCP merge in a 569-line function
parallel_state.py swallows Exception in node-locality and first-rank checks and returns fallback booleans
mla_attention.forward_impl contains 337 lines of dense branching across DCP, PCP, quantization, sparse/dense, and CUDA-graph modes
Fused DCP gather handoff relies on module-level mutable state instead of an explicit parameter
builda_bmm_v1 swallows custom-op registration failure with a bare except
Spark TP4 backend keeps per-rank session state in module-level globals
Spark TP4 worker-termination policy is duplicated at every native call site
b12x_mla_sparse silently returns on DCP barrier failure during warmup
parallel_state.py is a high fan-out topology hub with broad seam blast radius
Largest production overlay modules have zero automated tests
Overlay correctness is validated only by whole-fleet benchmarks, not in-repo tests
CUDA-required tests are not discoverable/runnable via normal pytest
Some unit tests rely on fragile module-level mocking rather than clean seams
The fused DCP gather handoff between indexer and attention has no dedicated test
